name: Back Office Staff
description: Invite staff by email, set roles (owner, manager, staff) with a plain explanation of what each can do, and remove people who've left.
usage: Give it the /admin/staff route, owner only. Send invites and role changes through your auth provider in onInvite and onRoleChange, and enforce the same three roles in your database rules — hiding a button isn't security. Security: put every back-office screen behind sign-in (for example Supabase Auth or Clerk), let only the owner's account read or write this data (in Supabase, with row-level security on every table), and keep admin pages out of the public navigation and sitemap.
